newsitem.title: USA: KCBT HRW wheat ends higher, supported by CBOT corn.
newsitem.headline: KCBT HRW wheat ends higher, supported by CBOT corn.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed higher, largely drawing support from strong gains in CBOT corn, KCBT traders said.

CBOT corn futures closed higher after weekly ratings released late Monday showed little improvement in the U.S. crop, plus forecasts called for hot, dry weather to return late this week to the Midwest.

Traders said Pakistan's purchase of 200,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 250,000 of Australian wheat and 50,000 of Canadian wheat was as expected and did not appear to be a significant factor in Tuesday's gains.
Cash wheat sales increased this week but KCBT traders said hedge selling was not evident in Tuesday's trading.
KCBT HRW wheat closed up two cents a bushel to unchanged with September up the most at $3.67 per bushel.
KCBT HRW wheat volume was estimated at 34.39 million bushels.
